
  run [flags]
    Measure a workload against a queue

    Appends seeded payloads, reads them back, or kills a writer mid-stream, then
    reports throughput and latency. `--mode` chooses what is measured: produce
    writes (the default), consume reads, mix runs producers and consumers over
    the same queues, and recovery times how fast a queue reopens after a crash.
    A flag only another mode reads is rejected, and a scenario named by `--file`
    may declare its own mode.

  USAGE
    bench run [flags] [--mode produce|consume|mix|recovery]

  FLAGS
    STORAGE
      --durability           <enum>      Ack policy: sync fsyncs before the offset returns, async flushes in the background (default async)
      --encryption           <enum>      At-rest protection: none, os directories, or aes-sealed payloads (create-only) (default none)
      --compaction           <enum>      Drop superseded keys when a segment closes (default none)
      --max-segment          <bytes>     Bytes per segment file (default 256 MiB)
      --max-segment-age      <duration>  Maximum age before a segment rolls (default 1h0m0s)
      --max-payload          <bytes>     Largest payload an append accepts (default 1 MiB)
      --max-cache            <bytes>     Tail cache budget in bytes (default 128 MiB)

    FLUSH
      --max-flush-bytes      <bytes>     Flush once the pending WAL reaches this many bytes (default 4 MiB)
      --max-flush-wait       <duration>  Longest a batch waits before flushing (default 10ms)

    RETENTION
      --max-retention-age    <duration>  Drop closed segments older than this; 0 keeps forever (default unlimited)
      --max-retention-bytes  <bytes>     Keep at most this many bytes of history; 0 keeps forever (default unlimited)

    TASK
      --lease                <duration>  Lease length assigned to a dequeued task (default 30s)
      --max-attempts         <uint32>    Deliveries before a task is dead-lettered (default 5)
      --max-in-flight        <uint32>    Concurrent-lease upper bound (default 100000)
      --max-dead-letters     <uint32>    Dead-letter upper bound (default 100000)

    WORKLOAD
      --mode                 <string>    What the run measures: produce, consume, mix, or recovery (default produce)
      --kind                 <string>    Queue kind: log or task (default log)
      --queues               <int>       Number of queues to spread load across (default 1)
      --msg-size             <bytes>     Payload size in bytes (default 1 KiB)
      --bytes                <bytes>     Total bytes to write before stopping
      --duration             <duration>  Total measure-phase duration (default 1m0s)
      --rate                 <uint32>    Target messages/s; 0 = unthrottled (produce|mix only) (default 0)
      --rate-schedule        <string>    Rate schedule: '0:0,30s:100k,60s:10k' (produce|mix only)
      --workers              <int>       Concurrent client workers (default 8)
      --batch                <int>       Messages per API call (default 64)
      --keys                 <int>       Distinct key cardinality; 0 = unkeyed (produce|mix only) (default 0)
      --preload              <bytes>     Bytes written before measurement (populate phase) (consume|mix only) (default unlimited)
      --ack-rate             <float>     Fraction of task dequeues that Ack (rest Nack) (consume|mix only) (default 0.9)
      --crash-after-bytes    <bytes>     Bytes written before simulated crash (recovery only)
      --seed                 <uint32>    PRNG seed for payload generation and ack decisions (default 0)

    OPTIONS
      --dir                  <string>    Data directory (embedded and daemon access) (default mikyu-bench)
      --encryption-key-file  <string>    File of hex AES-256 master keys for --encryption aes
      --target               <string>    Remote target to dial
      --access               <string>    How to reach mikyu: embedded, daemon, or remote (default embedded)
      --out                  <string>    Directory the run is written under (default bench)
      --persist              <bool>      Keep the spawned daemon and queues after the run
      --cleanup-stale        <bool>      Remove queues recorded by previous runs (default true)
      --quiet                <bool>      Suppress the progress bar
      --verify               <bool>      Verify every payload the run reads
      --cold                 <bool>      Drop the page cache before measuring
      --cpu                  <int>       GOMAXPROCS override; 0 leaves it alone
      --metric               <string>    Series metric to retain; repeatable
      --file                 <string>    Scenario YAML file; --mode overrides its mode

  EXAMPLES
    > mikyu bench run --dir ./data --bytes 1GiB
    > mikyu bench run --mode consume --preload 512MiB --verify
